topic: Kalpana Chawla first Indian-born woman in space
hook: If you grew up in Karnal, so did an astronaut.
title: A girl from Karnal who flew on a shuttle
description:
Kalpana Chawla was born in Karnal, Haryana. In 1997 she flew aboard Space Shuttle Columbia and became the first Indian-born woman in space. India later named its Kalpana-1 satellite in her honour.
